title: Cancelling your Zapp+ membership
text: You can cancel Zapp+ any time under Settings > Membership > Cancel. Your benefits stay active until the end of the period you've already paid for, and there are no partial refunds for the current cycle. You can rejoin whenever you like.
questions: How can I cancel my Zapp+ membership?
Will I still have access to my benefits after I cancel?
Is there a refund if I cancel my Zapp+ membership before the period ends?
Can I reactivate my Zapp+ membership after I cancel it?
